description: For electrical call, this inspection checklist records hazard screen, diagnostic boundary, outage plan, repair options, parts, permit needs, and price authorization. Its supporting evidence includes voltage or continuity readings, panel labels, thermal or condition photos, fault findings, and functional test.

blocks.guidance: Mark each electrical call item after direct review.
items: Affected circuits, devices, controls, and loads operate as intended
Covers, labels, grounding, protection, and enclosures are restored
No exposed conductor, abnormal heat, odor, arcing, or damage remains
Required voltage, continuity, polarity, or functional checks are recorded
Affected finishes and the work area are clean and secure
Customer limits, shutoff location, and follow-up work are explained

subtitle: Electrical Call Inspection Checklist: residential electrical service call dispatch using panel, hazard screen, and voltage or continuity readings.
title: Electrical Call Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during residential electrical service call dispatch when the electrical call record must identify panel, breaker, circuit, device, symptom, affected loads, occupancy, access, and prior modifications. Complete the applicable handoff for safe re-energization, label correction, customer explanation, permit status, repair warranty, and service record.
